description: Return all spendable + spent notes for a view key without setting up a watch. The view key never touches our SQLite — it flows through to NFPT in memory only. Use this when you want to reconcile a wallet at a point in time. Priced at $0.50 / call at the REST surface.

birthdayHeight.description: Skip scanning earlier blocks. Zcash auto-detects when omitted (slower but always correct).

includeNotes.description: Include a per-note breakdown (value/height/tx_hash/spent) in the response. Default false — totals only.

toHeight.description: Stop scanning at this block height. Defaults to chain tip.

viewKey.description: Monero: 64-hex private view key. Zcash: UFVK starting with uview1.

name: seneschal_private_watch_historical
title: One-off historical scan (paid via x402 at REST)
